During the [[Imperial Era]], this [[human]] '''officer''' served within the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Senate Security]], tasked with providing security for the [[Imperial Senate]].

==Biography==
In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{Andor|Messenger}} dates the third arc of [[Andor Season 2|''Andor'' Season 2]] to [[2 BBY]].</ref> they were on duty guarding the [[turbolift]] at [[Gate 9]] of the [[Imperial Senate Building]] when [[Senior Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] delivered a speech rebuking the [[Ghorman Massacre]]. During the speech they allowed [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] to enter the turbolift using [[Erskin Semaj]]'s credentials. Following the speech they were still guarding the lift when Andor and Mothma exited the lift at Gate 9 and was rushed my [[journalist]]s trying to get comments on her speech.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

As Mothma made her way through the crowd, a human named [[Beska]] aimed their [[blaster]] on Mothma claiming to be making an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] authorized arrest and telling the security officer to contact their supervisor. Before they could make the call to their supervisor, Semaj, Mothma's aid, distracted Beska giving Andor the chance to draw his [[Clem's blaster pistol|blaster]] and shoot Beska. Andor then immediately turns to aim his [[blaster pistol]] at the security officer who raises their arms and lowers themselves to their knees. After picking up Beska's blaster, Semaj used it to cover the officer in order to give Mothma and Andor a clear escape before Semaj too leaves the senate building.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Personality and traits==
The officer was a [[human]] with dark skin, [[color|black]] [[hair]] and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Equipment==
While working as a [[security officer]] they wore a [[Imperial officer's uniform|uniform]] consisting of a [[Color|blue]] tunic, black pants and a black hat. They also wore a [[rank insignia plaque]] with three blue tiles denoting their [[Military rank|rank]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The senator appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> Credited as "Senate Officer", they were portrayed by [[Nicholas A. Newman ]] in the episode.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />
